title: Saul Consults a Medium

questions.question: Who gathered their forces for war against Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 28:1 (ESV): “In those days the Philistines gathered their forces for war...”

questions.question: What had Saul done regarding mediums and necromancers?
options: Put them out of the land
questions.correctAnswer: Put them out of the land
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 28:3 (ESV): “...and Saul had put the mediums and the necromancers out of the land.”

questions.question: Why did Saul seek a medium?
options: The Lord did not answer him by dreams, Urim, or prophets
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord did not answer him by dreams, Urim, or prophets
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 28:6 (ESV): “And when Saul inquired of the Lord, the Lord did not answer him, either by dreams, or by Urim, or by prophets.”

questions.question: Who did Saul ask the medium to bring up?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 28:11 (ESV): “...He said, ‘Bring up Samuel for me.’”

questions.question: What message did Samuel give Saul?
options: Note: The Lord has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to David; you will die tomorrow
questions.correctAnswer: Note: The Lord has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to David; you will die tomorrow
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 28:17, 19 (ESV): “...The Lord has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to... David... tomorrow you and your sons shall be with me...”

questions.question: Where did the medium live?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 28:7 (ESV): "...Behold, there is a medium at En-dor."

questions.question: How did Saul disguise himself?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 28:8 (ESV): "So Saul disguised himself and put on other garments..."

questions.question: What did the woman see that made her cry out?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 28:12-13 (ESV): "When the woman saw Samuel, she cried out... 'I see a god coming up out of the earth.'"

questions.question: How did the woman realize it was Saul?
options: When she saw Samuel (prophetic insight stimulated by the vision)
questions.correctAnswer: When she saw Samuel (prophetic insight stimulated by the vision)
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 28:12 (ESV): "When the woman saw Samuel, she cried out... 'Why have you deceived me? You are Saul.'"

questions.question: What did the woman persuade Saul to do before he left?
options: Eat some food (fatted calf and unleavened bread)
questions.correctAnswer: Eat some food (fatted calf and unleavened bread)
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 28:22-24 (ESV): "...let me set a morsel of bread before you; and eat... she took flour... and baked unleavened bread."

questions.question: Where were the Philistines camped?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 28:4 (ESV): "The Philistines assembled and came and encamped at Shunem."

questions.question: Where did Saul gather all Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 28:4 (ESV): "...And Saul gathered all Israel, and they encamped at Gilboa."

questions.question: How was Samuel described by the woman?
options: An old man wrapped in a robe
questions.correctAnswer: An old man wrapped in a robe
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 28:14 (ESV): "...An old man is coming up, and he is wrapped in a robe."

questions.question: Why specifically was God angry with Saul according to Samuel in this vision?
options: Because he did not execute God's fierce wrath on Amalek
questions.correctAnswer: Because he did not execute God's fierce wrath on Amalek
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 28:18 (ESV): "Because you did not obey the voice of the LORD and did not carry out his fierce wrath against Amalek..."

questions.question: Achish made David his ______ for life.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 28:2 (ESV): "...Achish said to David, 'Therefore I will make you my bodyguard for life.'"

key_verse_text: And when Saul inquired of the LORD, the LORD did not answer him, either by dreams, or by Urim, or by prophets. (ESV)
